name: quiet-hours-field
title: Quiet hours field
description: Do not disturb on a schedule: a switch, from and to times, the days it applies to, and a sentence that understands overnight ranges.
docs: value is { enabled, from, to, days }: from and to are "HH:MM" in 24-hour time, and days are getDay() numbers (0 is Sunday) naming the days a quiet period starts on. A range that crosses midnight (22:00 to 07:00) is valid: the field says so, and a thin 24-hour track shows where the quiet falls in two pieces. From equal to To is refused with a message, and so is turning off the last day; a refused change is never reported. The days are toggle chips named by the whole weekday, in the language of locale, in a row that starts on weekStartsOn (default Monday). A sentence in a polite live region says the schedule, "Quiet from 22:00 to 07:00, Monday to Friday". Switching it off dims and locks the rest but clears nothing, so switching it on again brings the old schedule back. minuteStep sets the times in the list, disabled turns the whole field off, and labels renames every word, including the ones in the sentences.
